about: A passage in a slot is trimmed at its ends: the leaflet's padded `short` reads "a leaflet." with no space before the full stop, and its two-paragraph `back`, blank lines at both ends, breaks the line it is put in once, between its paragraphs, and nowhere else. `back` said on its own reads as it always has.

expect.words: There is nothing special about a hall.
Turning it over: It is printed on both sides.
The back is blank. Nothing more.
It is printed on both sides.
